title.zh: 强化学习：智能体怎么在试错里学会长远打算
title.en: Reinforcement Learning: How Agents Learn Long-Horizon Decisions from Trial and Error

desc.zh: 从探索与利用、贝尔曼方程、TD 与策略梯度，到 PPO/GRPO、MCTS 与奖励黑客——九个交互模型拆解强化学习如何从延迟奖惩里学会长远决策。
desc.en: From exploration vs exploitation, Bellman equations, TD and policy gradients, to PPO/GRPO, MCTS, and reward hacking — nine interactive models of learning under delayed rewards.

title.zh: 探索与利用：多臂老虎机与 UCB1
title.en: Exploration vs Exploitation: Multi-Armed Bandits & UCB1

desc.zh: 在未知收益下权衡选眼下最好与试未知选项，上置信界按不确定性给冷门选项加探索奖金。
desc.en: Trade off pulling the best-known option against testing uncertain arms using UCB1 uncertainty bonuses.

title.zh: 马尔可夫决策过程与贝尔曼方程

desc.zh: 用折扣因子 γ 把未来收益折现到现在，将长程回报拆解成即时奖励加下一格的折现价值。
desc.en: Discount future payoffs by γ to fold multi-step returns into immediate reward plus discounted next-state value.

title.zh: 动态规划：值迭代与策略迭代

desc.zh: 已知状态转移矩阵时，借助贝尔曼压缩映射以率 γ 指数收束到全局最优价值 V*。
desc.en: When transitions are known, Bellman contraction backups converge exponentially at rate γ to optimal V*.

title.zh: 时序差分控制：Q-Learning 与 SARSA

desc.zh: 无地图试错时，异策略 Q-Learning 学贴崖最短路径，同策略 SARSA 计入探索失误而绕行保命。
desc.en: Without a map, off-policy Q-Learning learns the risky cliff-edge optimum while on-policy SARSA prices in exploration noise.

title.zh: 策略梯度与基线降方差（REINFORCE）

desc.zh: 直接沿梯度推高高回报动作概率，减去均值基线在不引入偏置的前提下把梯度方差压低数十倍。
desc.en: Directly raise log-probabilities of high-return actions while subtracting a baseline slashes gradient variance with zero bias.

desc.zh: PPO 用截断比值窗口与 KL 惩罚防止步子迈太大崩溃；GRPO 用组内相对得分取代 Critic 网络大幅省显存。
desc.en: PPO clips probability ratios and regularizes KL divergence; GRPO drops the critic network using within-group rewards.

title.zh: 蒙特卡洛树搜索与自我对弈

desc.zh: 用 UCT 平衡选择与探索前推博弈树，把昂贵的未来分支推演变成可收敛到极小极大最优解的思考预算。
desc.en: Combine UCT lookahead rollouts and backpropagation to converge toward minimax-optimal play as search budget grows.

title.zh: 奖励黑客与古德哈特定律

desc.zh: 当可刷取的代理塑形分数跨过临界阈值，严格最优算法会放弃真实目标在原地死循环刷分。
desc.en: Once a farmable proxy bonus crosses the Bellman threshold, even an optimal solver loops to exploit it instead of finishing.

title.zh: RL 前沿版图：RLVR 推理与机器人 Sim-to-Real
title.en: RL Frontier: RLVR Reasoning & Robotics Sim-to-Real

desc.zh: 梳理可验证推理、单卡 15 分钟人形仿真迁移以及思维链监控税等截至 2026 年 11 月的研究进展边界。
desc.en: Map verifiable reasoning (RLVR), 15-minute humanoid sim-to-real transfer, and CoT monitorability tradeoffs as of Nov 2026.
